description: A browser-based, agent-friendly debugging library for Android: an embedded debug server with a network inspector, used from a desktop browser or as a JSON API.
rules: Add io.github.twinsen81:lustro with debugImplementation and io.github.twinsen81:lustro-noop with releaseImplementation. Never put both on one configuration: they declare the same Gradle capability.
Build Lustro once, in Application.onCreate(), and call start() there, on the main thread. Add every tab before build(): after start(), addTab() throws IllegalStateException.
Add lustro.networkInterceptor() with addInterceptor, not addNetworkInterceptor, after the app's own interceptors that change the URL, the headers, or the body.
Put DebugTab subclasses (custom tabs) in src/debug. The published lint check LustroDebugUsageInRelease reports them in other source sets.
The server binds 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device and listens only while the app is in the foreground. Use adb forward tcp:8080 tcp:8080, and read the token with adb logcat -d -s LustroToken.
API clients send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Read GET /api/v1/_meta and GET /api/v1/<id>/_schema at runtime instead of hard-coding routes.
